Short Stanza III: Too lightly woven must the garments be
Epigram LIII. — Lines woven in a Robe
Allah, my sleep is woven through, it seems
On a Brede of divers Colours, woven by four Ladies.
On a Locket of Hair Wove in a True-Loves Knot, Given Me by Sir R. O.
Song: The wreath you wove, the wreath you wove
Song: As once a Grecian maiden wove
